title: A pool-share trustline removed by an AllowTrust or SetTrustLineFlags revocation gets no TRUSTLINE REMOVE state change
severity_basis: TRUSTLINE REMOVE rows come only from addChangeTrustEffects, which runs for ChangeTrust only, so when an AllowTrust or SetTrustLineFlags revocation makes stellar-core redeem pool shares and remove the pool-share trustline (CAP-38), no row records the removal and the account's history shows the trustline as still open. The pool-share balance itself is recorded correctly and ingestion does not halt.

entries.expected: a TRUSTLINE REMOVE state change, with the pool's liquidity_pool_id, for the pool-share trustline the revocation removes
entries.observed: Executed through the replay harness at 3e22515a and at 18db88f4, all four variants, both inputs: dropped · partial, no trustline_removed for GAIXNEYG… on pool 16c943ea… in the SetTrustLineFlags transaction (050f8c41… on the pubnet variants, e060d79e… on the testnet variants); every other compared fact matched. By hand at 18db88f4 on pubnet ledger 50914934, transaction 6b1d2cb8… (AllowTrust): the holder gets only BALANCE_AUTHORIZATION CLEAR.

evidence.pre_fix: make replay-full (the whole corpus against wallet-backend at the pinned current commit, both inputs): dropped · partial on all four variants of cap-0038/auth-revocation-redeems-pool-shares at 3e22515a and again at 18db88f4. The issue's test (internal/indexer/revoke_pool_shares_mainnet_test.go) at 18db88f4 on pubnet ledger 50914934 from the public data lake fails: expected 1 TRUSTLINE REMOVE, actual 0 (the reproduction in the upstream issue).
evidence.expected_basis: CAP-38 (https://github.com/stellar/stellar-protocol/blob/master/core/cap-0038.md): revoking authorization redeems the holder's pool shares into claimable balances and removes the pool-share trustline; the operation meta shows the trustline LEDGER_ENTRY_REMOVED, and a ChangeTrust removal of the same trustline produces a TRUSTLINE REMOVE row.

reproduction.method: make replay-full at 18db88f4 (both inputs): dropped · partial on all four variants, as at 3e22515a; the issue's test, run at 18db88f4 before filing on 2026-11-19, fails as the issue shows.

queries: stellar/wallet-backend: every issue and pull request title, open and closed
stellar/wallet-backend: open pull requests touching the effects processors

history.note: Recorded on 2026-11-19: filed by the maintainers of this kit on 2026-11-19 as https://github.com/stellar/wallet-backend/issues/831; this record restates the public issue.

Executed again at the pinned current commit f0c00cf5 (make replay-full, both inputs): the same rows as at 18db88f4; the entries' divergences name f0c00cf5. The commits between them change only the GraphQL server's metrics (internal/serve, internal/metrics), not ingest.
